findings.title: Bulk sensitive data exposure
findings.description: An endpoint returns a list of records with personal or financial fields, and it is either reachable without a token or not documented, so nobody reviewed what it hands out.
findings.detail: GET /accounts/{id} (account-service) returns a list with financial fields
findings.owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
findings.recommendation: Reduce fields and require an admin role on /accounts/{id}.
mitigation: Return only the fields the client needs (response schema / DTO, not the raw record).
Paginate with a hard maximum and require an admin role for bulk export.
Log every bulk export with the caller identity.

findings.title: Sensitive operation answers anonymous callers
findings.description: Requests with no credential at all got a 2xx response from an endpoint that returns sensitive data or changes state.
findings.detail: POST /accounts/ (account-service) returned 2xx to 15 request(s) without a token
factors: likelihood +1: anonymous success seen on the public path
findings.recommendation: Add authentication to POST /accounts/ in account-service.
mitigation: Require a verified token on this operation in the service itself, not only at the gateway.
Reject requests without Authorization with 401 before any business logic runs.
Add a test that calls the endpoint anonymously and expects 401.

findings.title: Gateway route forwards requests without authentication
findings.description: A gateway route is configured with no authentication and forwards to endpoints that are not login endpoints, so the gateway is not acting as an authentication boundary.
findings.detail: route /accounts/** -> account-service has auth: unspecified
findings.recommendation: Set auth: required on gateway route /accounts.
mitigation: Set auth: required on the route, or split public paths (login) into their own route.
Deny by default: routes without an explicit auth setting should be rejected at deploy time.
findings.snippet:
routes:
  - prefix: /api/payments
    service: payment-service
    auth: required      # was: none

findings.title: Login has no visible brute-force protection
findings.description: The login endpoint returned failures but never a 429 or lockout, and no rate-limiting directive in the gateway or Ingress configuration covers it, so password guessing is not being slowed down.
findings.detail: POST /uaa/oauth/token (auth-service): 15 failed logins, no 429 seen
evidence: no rate-limiting directive on its gateway route or Ingress
findings.recommendation: Add rate limiting and lockout to /uaa/oauth/token.
mitigation: Rate-limit login per account and per IP (e.g. 5 failures / 15 min) and return 429.
Add MFA for privileged accounts and alert on failure spikes.

findings.title: Public entry serves the API without TLS
findings.description: The public entry (Ingress, load balancer, Istio Gateway or published port) has no TLS, so Authorization headers and personal data sent through it can be read or replayed on the network. The evidence says how many public endpoints carried them in this capture.
findings.detail: published port (docker compose) gateway serves the API over plain HTTP
findings.recommendation: Enable TLS on published port (docker compose) gateway.
mitigation: Terminate TLS at the ingress (tls: section + certificate) and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
Send Strict-Transport-Security so browsers never fall back to HTTP.
findings.snippet:
spec:
  tls:
    - hosts: [api.example.com]
      secretName: api-tls

findings.title: No network segmentation for the service
findings.description: No NetworkPolicy selects this workload, so every pod in the cluster can call it. One compromised pod can move laterally.
findings.detail: account-mongodb accepts traffic from any pod
evidence: callers seen in traces: none (only external clients)
findings.recommendation: Add a NetworkPolicy for account-mongodb allowing only: the ingress controller.
mitigation: Add a default-deny NetworkPolicy for the namespace, then allow only the callers seen in traces.

steps.title: Set auth: required on gateway route /accounts.
mitigation: Set auth: required on the route, or split public paths (login) into their own route.
Deny by default: routes without an explicit auth setting should be rejected at deploy time.

steps.title: Enforce authentication and role checks on GET /accounts/{id} (account-service)
mitigation: Return only the fields the client needs (response schema / DTO, not the raw record).
Paginate with a hard maximum and require an admin role for bulk export.
Log every bulk export with the caller identity.

steps.title: Enforce authentication and role checks on POST /accounts/ (account-service)

Reject requests without Authorization with 401 before any business logic runs.
Add a test that calls the endpoint anonymously and expects 401.
